cohort: 84 pregnancies in women with systemic lupus erythematosus referred to a Danish university hospital from a stable referral area with approximately 1.4 million inhabitants during 1990-2010
finding: Pregnancies in women with SLE were mostly successful, but maternal and fetal complications were observed in one-half and one-third of cases, respectively.
mod_finding: Significantly higher rates of premature delivery and caesarean section were found in the SLE cohort compared to the general population.
birth_weight: Lower in the SLE cohort compared to the general population
